site_acres.label: Site, acres
site_acres.assumption: A single-line mainstream store with a 40,000 sq ft building; the local competitors with a stated site sit on 14.84 to 17.586 acres [^20]. The subject is held at the low end of the range.

land_psf.label: Land price per sq ft
land_psf.assumption: Set at the 2026 asking-price level for I-20 hard-corner frontage in Weatherford. The listing is not cited so that no real parcel is identified; an appraisal sets the value.

bldg_sf.label: Building, sq ft (showroom, offices, parts, service)
bldg_sf.assumption: Smaller than every local franchised store with a known size (47,038 to 105,344 sq ft) [^20,13]; sized for one mainstream line-make. The manufacturer's facility program sets the final size.

bldg_psf.label: Building cost per sq ft, 2021 to 2022 local dealership registration

escalation.label: Escalation from the 2021 estimate to a 2027 build
escalation.assumption: The research has no construction cost index to carry the 2021 registry figure forward. Construction input costs rose 8.9% in the year to August 2026 alone and contractors' bid prices 3.5% in the year to June 2026 [^48,49]; 15% is an allowance, to be replaced by a general contractor's bid.

sitework_per_acre.label: Site work, paving, lot lighting and drainage per acre
sitework_per_acre.assumption: A dealership paves most of its site for display, customer and service parking. The research gives no site-work cost; this allowance stands until civil bids are in.

equipment.label: Service equipment (above-ground lifts, alignment, compressors), IT and furniture
equipment.assumption: Lift, service-equipment and IT costs are NOT FOUND in the research. Above-ground lifts are assumed so the service department is not a service center with pits and in-ground lifts on SBA's special purpose list [^56].

ae_pct.label: Architectural and engineering fees, share of building cost

soft_other.label: Permits, CUP application, survey, Phase I, appraisal, legal, title and lender fees
soft_other.assumption: Impact and connection fees and the CUP cost are NOT FOUND in the research; a placeholder pending the City of Weatherford fee schedule.

contingency_pct.label: Construction contingency, share of building, site work and equipment
contingency_pct.assumption: Standard allowance for a ground-up build; no local figure in the research.

draw_factor.label: Average share of the construction budget outstanding during the build
draw_factor.assumption: Draws rise from zero to the full budget over the build, so about half is outstanding on average.

new_units.label: New vehicles retailed
new_units.assumption: The average franchised store retailed 955 new vehicles in 2025 [^39]. The research has no ramp benchmark for an open point, so the store reaches 84% of that average in Year 3 and 94% in Year 5.

new_gpu.label: Front-end gross profit per new vehicle

used_share.label: Used vehicles, share of dealership sales dollars

new_share.label: New vehicles, share of dealership sales dollars

used_price.label: Average used-vehicle retail price
used_price.assumption: Not in the research. Held above the $27,528 average amount financed on a used vehicle in Q4 2025 [^39], because buyers finance less than the price.

used_gpu.label: Front-end gross profit per used vehicle

fi_pu.label: Finance and insurance income per vehicle retailed

sp_sales_nada.label: Service and parts sales, average franchised store

sp_share.label: Subject service and parts sales, share of the average store
sp_share.assumption: A new point starts with few of its brand's vehicles in operation nearby; service volume builds as units are sold. No ramp benchmark is in the research.

sp_margin.label: Service and parts gross margin
sp_margin.assumption: The only service and parts margin in the research is the 37.6% that America's franchised truck dealers earned in 2025 [^42]; it is used for this light-vehicle store as a proxy.

sga_pct.label: Selling, general and administrative expense, share of gross profit
sga_pct.assumption: AutoNation's SG&A ran at 67.9% of gross profit in FY2025 [^46]. A start-up store carries its full staff and launch advertising before volume arrives, so the ratio starts higher and reaches the benchmark in Year 5.

fp_rate.label: Floorplan interest rate
fp_rate.assumption: Floorplan terms are NOT FOUND in the research. Prime was 7.00% on the H.15 release of October 9, 2026 [^58]; the model adds 0.50% and counts no manufacturer floorplan assistance.

vit_factor.label: Vehicle inventory tax unit factor (city, ISD and county)

tax_rate.label: Combined property tax rate (city, ISD, county), tax year 2025

insurance.label: Property, garage liability and open-lot insurance, Year 1
insurance.assumption: Insurance conditions (wind, hail, flood, wildfire) are NOT FOUND in the research. A placeholder until a broker quote is in the file.

tpl_rate.label: Bank first-lien rate
tpl_rate.assumption: The research has no bank rate. Prime was 7.00% on October 9, 2026 [^58]; the model uses 7.25% fixed. The rate is set at pricing

tpl_amort_years.label: Bank first-lien amortization
tpl_amort_years.assumption: Matches the 25-year debenture; the bank may set a shorter maturity with the same amortization.

uses.label: Land, 5.0 acres at the assumed I-20 price per sq ft
Permits, CUP, survey, Phase I, appraisal, legal
Contingency
uses.expr: (bldg_sf * bldg_psf * (1 + escalation) + site_acres * sitework_per_acre + equipment) * contingency_pct

uses.label: Construction-period interest
uses.expr: (bldg_sf * bldg_psf * (1 + escalation) + site_acres * sitework_per_acre + equipment) * draw_factor * tpl_rate * build_months / 12

revenue.label: Finance and insurance income
revenue.expr: (new_units + new_units * new_price * used_share / new_share / used_price) * fi_pu

cost_of_sales.label: Cost of service and parts sales

opex.label: Property tax on land, building and equipment
opex.expr: (site_acres * 43560 * land_psf + bldg_sf * bldg_psf * (1 + escalation) + site_acres * sitework_per_acre + equipment) * tax_rate
